clusters.name: anthropic-opt-in-gate
clusters.executionModeRationale: All stories mutate the same small set of interlocking files (copilot_models_endpoint.rs, copilot.rs, chat_transport.rs, client.rs, patch-surface.md) in a strict dependency order; every story depends on the US-001 gate helper. Splitting across parallel members would produce conflicting edits. Run serially as one impl member.
